from datetime import datetime
from decimal import Decimal
import datason

data = {
    "created": datetime(2026, 10, 4),
    "price": Decimal("19.99"),
}
text = datason.dumps(data,
                     include_type_hints=False)
print(text)
api.description: Plain JSON for your client. Decimal stays precise as a string.

storage.code:
from datetime import datetime
from decimal import Decimal
import datason

data = {
    "created": datetime(2026, 10, 4),
    "price": Decimal("19.99"),
}
text = datason.dumps(data)
restored = datason.loads(text)
assert restored == data
print(text)
storage.description: Type metadata lets datason restore the datetime and Decimal.

import datason

data = {
    "event": "signed_in",
    "email": "alice@example.com",
    "api_token": "private-token",
}
text = datason.dumps(data,
    redact_fields=("token",),
    redact_patterns=("email",))
print(text)
